title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：murder　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 murder 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the clerk ① reported the murder that no applicant in the office would have recorded, and he said the reporting was the whole of the month. The ② murder, meaning the killing itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a murder, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ murder in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ murder at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A murder, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the clerk said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the murder was the whole of the matter, meaning the crime and not the killing. The ⑥ murder, meaning the crime and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; murder, he said, is either something you report or the only word that means both a killing and a crime. He said the crime is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ murder had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ murder of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of recording; murder, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ murder I remember is the killing recorded in the file, which closed in 1998 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ murder, my mother said in 2000, is the only killing that improves by being recorded; every murder, she said, is a crime that has agreed to look like a killing. She said the crime was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 谋杀；凶案（指办事处里每一起旁边的那一起）
B. n. 谋杀；凶案（指那起谋杀本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：report the murder 报案这一起谋杀
D. n. 谋杀；凶案（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 谋杀之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的谋杀之事）
F. n. 谋杀；凶案（指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一起）
G. n. 谋杀、罪孽（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 罪孽（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: reported the murder that no applicant in the office would have recorded
The murder, meaning the killing itself and not the stamp
the murder at the far counter
the murder was the whole of the matter
the murder had become a line in a file
The murder of the whole thing
A murder, my mother said in 2000

answers.why: report the murder 意为“报案这一起谋杀”，1991 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记载的一起谋杀做了一遍。
murder 意为“谋杀；凶案”，指那起谋杀本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
murder 意为“谋杀；凶案”，指办事处里每一起旁边的那一起，每一起旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
murder 意为“谋杀；凶案”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
murder 意为“谋杀、罪孽”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这起罪孽就是那件事的全部。
murder 意为“罪孽”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那起谋杀，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
murder 意为“谋杀；凶案”，指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一起，到 1996 年这一起成了卷宗里的一行。
murder 意为“谋杀之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的谋杀之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记载。
murder 意为“谋杀；凶案”，我记得的是卷宗里记载过的那一起，1998 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一起。
murder 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，谋杀是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的谋杀。
